** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tuticorin Port**

 
 
• It is also known as **V. O. Chidambaranar Port Trust**.
 
• **It was declared a major port on 11 July 1974**.
 
• It is the **second-largest port in Tamil Nadu **and the **fourth-largest container terminal in India**.
 
 
 
• **Haldia Port**
 
 
• Haldia Port is situated in **West Bengal**.
 
• Haldia Dock Complex has been built at the confluence of the Haldi River and Hooghly river.
 
• The main imports from this port are petroleum, chemicals, and parts.
 
• Exports include coal, iron ore, steel etc.
 
 
 
• **New Mangalore port**:
 
 
• **New Mangalore was declared India's 9th Major Port on May 4, 1974.**
 
• It was formally inaugurated by former prime minister Indira Gandhi on January 11, 1975.
 
• **It is also known as the Panambur Port**.
 
• **It is located in Dakshina Kannada district, at a site called Panambur of Karnataka.**
 
• New Mangalore Port is located at **Gurupura river **confluence with the Arabian Sea.
 
• It is the deepest inner harbour on the west coast.
 
• It is the only major port of Karnataka and the seventh-largest port in India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Largest Port of India: Mumbai port
 
• Oldest Port of India: Kolkata Port (1870), now renamed Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Port.
 
• Largest artificial port: Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Navi Mumbai
